system.description:
Most people flinch putting a bow to full draw with an enemy already inside their reach. You don't — you put the shot exactly where you meant to, close enough to feel their breath. No Disadvantage for using ranged weapons within 5ft reach of an enemy.

Available to: Rogues, Assassins, Rangers, Monks, Archers, Gunslingers, Swashbucklers, and Artificers.

rules.value: Point-Blank Terror: no Disadvantage for ranged attacks within 5ft of an enemy.
